findings.evidence: roadmap `Diffraction/README.md:276` `- t = Δ²;`; `Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:68 def tMom`; `Kinematics/TargetMass.lean:63 def M2`; the only occurrence of `t` in the new API is the inline expression at line 138.
findings.fix: Add `tMom (g) (K) := g (K.p - K.pPrime) (K.p - K.pPrime)` with a `tMom_def := (rfl)` and restate `beta_eq_of_MX2` with it. Putting it on `DisKinematics` (next to `M2` in `Kinematics/TargetMass.lean`) lets the announced `ExclKinematics extends DisKinematics` bridge subsume `ExclKinematics.tMom` instead of leaving two names for Δ² on one record.
findings.issue: `t = Δ²` is an explicitly named §0.1 variable but gets no declaration, so the layer's headline relation is stated with the raw bilinear `g (K.p - K.pPrime) (K.p - K.pPrime)` inline, and every consumer of `t` (0.2's `t ≤ 0` and `t_min`, 1.1's `F₂^{D(4)}(β, Q², ξ, t)`, 1.2's `t`-integration) must respell it.

findings.evidence: `Kinematics/Basic.lean:98 lemma W2_eq_with_Q2` is the upstream sibling of `W2_expand`, which line 107 names as `MX2_expand`'s counterpart; roadmap `Diffraction/README.md:285` "Equivalently `M_X² = Q²(1/β - 1) + t`".
findings.fix: Add `MX2_eq_with_Q2 : MX2 g K = -K.Q2 g + 2 * g K.q (K.p - K.pPrime) + g (K.p - K.pPrime) (K.p - K.pPrime)` (parallel to `DisKinematics.W2_eq_with_Q2`) and the inverse form `MX2 g K = K.Q2 g * (1 / beta g K - 1) + t` under the needed non-degeneracy.
findings.issue: `MX2_expand` leaves `g K.q K.q` where the rest of the API speaks in `Q2`, and the roadmap's equivalent form `M_X² = Q²(1/β − 1) + t` has no declaration; a consumer must redo the `Q2`-substitution and invert `beta_eq_of_MX2` by hand.

findings.evidence: roadmap `Diffraction/README.md:288` "- The `y`-independence of `ξ`, `β` and `t`: they are functions of `q`, `P`, `P'` alone."; `Kinematics/Basic.lean:32-45` shows `k`/`kPrime` are separate fields constrained only by `hq : q = k - kPrime`.
findings.fix: Expose congruence lemmas, e.g. `xi_congr`/`beta_congr`: given `K₁.p = K₂.p`, `K₁.pPrime = K₂.pPrime`, `K₁.q = K₂.q`, conclude `xi g K₁ = xi g K₂` (one-line `simp [xi_def, ...]`).
findings.issue: The §0.1 theorem that `ξ`, `β` (and `t`) are functions of `q`, `P`, `P'` alone is asserted only in prose (module docstring, lines 17-19) and not stated. It is not vacuous in this encoding: `DisKinematics` also carries `k`, `kPrime`, so two records can share `p`, `pPrime`, `q` and differ elsewhere.

summary: Bodies are correctly unexposed with `(rfl)`-backed `_def` lemmas and nothing is over-exposed or compatibility-only, but three explicit §0.1 products are missing from the surface: a named `t = Δ²`, the `Q²`/inverse form of `M_X²`, and the y-independence statement.
